loginSubtitle: Sign in with an email code and continue from where you left off.
loginHeroTitle: One auth flow, one learning identity
loginHeroDescription: We now keep sign-in, guest access, and persistence on the same Supabase Auth path. You can explore as a guest first, then upgrade the current progress into a real account without starting over.
loginFeatureOneDesc: A lighter MVP flow with fewer recovery issues and less friction than password or SMS login.
loginFeatureTwoDesc: Anonymous users can upgrade in place. The user id stays the same, so sessions and saved data carry over.
loginFeatureThreeDesc: The web app uses a Supabase token, and the backend maps the same user into Prisma and Postgres.
loginSignupSubtitle: Enter your email, receive a one-time code, and verify to start saving progress long term.
loginSignupUpgradeSubtitle: You are currently in guest mode. Verify your email to upgrade this exact progress into a permanent account.
loginUpgradeBannerTitle: Recommended: upgrade your current guest progress
loginUpgradeBannerDesc: This does not create a second profile. It binds the current anonymous account to your email so your data stays in place.
